plain_summary: Review amitriptyline in a person with epilepsy or a history of seizures.

medicine_groups.name: Systemic amitriptyline
medicine_groups.note: Count oral amitriptyline. Exclude topical compounds used for local treatment. Check an unclear route before counting systemic exposure.

rule_for_models: Report one finding when systemic amitriptyline is supplied and the record confirms epilepsy or a history of seizures at supply. Count any treatment indication and cite the supply and the clinical record or pharmacist answer establishing that history by the supply date. Give no finding if both epilepsy and a seizure history are excluded. If neither is established and either remains unknown, cite the supply and report only a possible finding naming the missing history. Ask whether the patient had epilepsy or had ever had a seizure by that supply. Ask about seizure control and the reason for amitriptyline when reviewing a finding.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you confirm whether this patient has epilepsy or a history of seizures and review seizure control and the suitability of amitriptyline?

needs_facts.meets: A clinical record or the pharmacist confirms epilepsy or a history of seizures by the reviewed supply date. Either qualifies. If both are excluded, there is no finding. Otherwise an unknown history remains open.

options.words: Epilepsy or a seizure history is confirmed by the time of supply
Both epilepsy and a seizure history are excluded at supply
